overview: Lira San is a outer rim territories world documented across the nine saga films, live-action and animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, and Old Sith Empire records.
history:
Lira San appears in records spanning the Old Republic, Clone Wars, Imperial era, Galactic Civil War, and Legacy periods. Archaeological surveys, holocrons, and veteran testimony preserve its place in galactic history.

Strategic value, cultural identity, and Force-sensitive traditions on Lira San shifted with each regime—from Sith occupation to Republic restoration and beyond.
significance: Lira San remains a reference point in Outer Rim Territories surveys, trade lane charts, and military campaign planning across the nine saga films, series, KOTOR, and the Old Sith Empire.
